# postprocess { #valley_floor.postprocess }

`postprocess`



## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [postprocess](#valley_floor.postprocess.postprocess) | Postprocess a valley floor raster. |

### postprocess { #valley_floor.postprocess.postprocess }

```python
postprocess.postprocess(
    floor,
    channel_network,
    dem,
    params=PostprocessingParameters(),
)
```

Postprocess a valley floor raster.

Applies three refinement steps in order: removes high-slope pixels,
fills small holes, and removes areas not connected to the channel network.
Channel network pixels are always included in the output.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                     | Description                                                                                                   | Default                      |
|-----------------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| floor           | xr.DataArray             | Binary valley floor raster to refine (uint8, nodata=255). Typically the valley_floor output from delineate(). | _required_                   |
| channel_network | xr.DataArray             | Full labeled stream network raster including headwaters, used for connectivity analysis.                      | _required_                   |
| dem             | xr.DataArray             | Digital elevation model, used to compute slope.                                                               | _required_                   |
| params          | PostprocessingParameters | Postprocessing parameters. Defaults to PostprocessingParameters().                                            | `PostprocessingParameters()` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                      |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------|
|        | xr.DataArray | Refined valley floor raster (uint8, nodata=255). |
